title: fetchmail is not locked to OpenSSL >= 3.1. According to the README.SSL file, it will work just fine with 3.0.
description:
fetchmail is not locked to OpenSSL >= 3.1. According to the README.SSL file, it will work just fine with 3.0.

As we are not going to merge neither OpenSSL 3.1 nor 3.2 (see https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/fetchmail/+bug/2052964) we should probably just patch debian/control.

The README.SSL also mentions this:

---
Use an up-to-date release of OpenSSL v3.0/v3.1 or wolfSSL 5.5 or
newer, so as to get TLSv1.3 support and latest fixes.  Older OpenSSL versions 
are unsupported upstream, and fetchmail rejects versions before v1.0.2f and 
warns about versions before 3.0.13.
---

The current version in Noble is 3.0.10 but it will be updated to 3.0.13. See https://code.launchpad.net/~adrien-n/ubuntu/+source/openssl/+git/openssl/+merge/461044


PPA: https://launchpad.net/~danilogondolfo/+archive/ubuntu/fetchmail

Autopkgtest logs:

https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-noble-danilogondolfo-fetchmail/noble/amd64/f/fetchmail/20240226_111514_5ee20@/log.gz

https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-noble-danilogondolfo-fetchmail/noble/armhf/f/fetchmail/20240226_113547_77ee0@/log.gz

https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-noble-danilogondolfo-fetchmail/noble/ppc64el/f/fetchmail/20240226_113653_b130e@/log.gz

https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-noble-danilogondolfo-fetchmail/noble/s390x/f/fetchmail/20240226_112754_a509b@/log.gz

The log for arm64 is missing due to an outage in launchpad.

index c21c4c0..74b8b75 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+fetchmail (6.4.38-1ubuntu1) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * debian/control: drop OpenSSL requirements to >= 3.0.10 (LP: #2052964)
+    According to the README.SSL file it works just fine with 3.0 but will
+    warn if it's < 3.0.13.
+
+ -- Danilo Egea Gondolfo <danilo.egea.gondolfo@canonical.com>  Mon, 26 Feb 2024 09:45:36 +0000
